method: Isolated final runs after tests/services stopped; five repetitions; alternating cache-mode order; no concurrent test jobs. Baseline measured on unmodified 0.23.0 checkout before implementation.

baseline_0.23.0.timing: Synchronized wall time, excluding model initialization and warm-up
notes: Rates use the measured scenario wall time; speedup compares modes on the same device.
Compare actual work too: terminal root wins can use fewer than the requested simulations.
Different trajectories or deadline cutoffs can change completed work; a single small run is not a general performance claim.
